notes.isolated-vm: Pinned to ^6.1.2 (not ^7.x) — isolated-vm 7.x requires node >=26, which has no LTS release yet (still Node's pre-LTS 'Current' line). 6.1.2 requires only node >=22, satisfied by the 24.x LTS line ('Krypton') this platform targets. This is an engines-range fix, not a build-tools issue — re-evaluate the pin once Node 26 reaches LTS and the platform's baseline moves to it.
